name: nexus-computer
description: NexusWindows for Antigravity: Windows computer use in the background (UI Automation, Win32 messages), real mouse and keyboard only as a fallback, every action read back, confirmation only to pay, send or publish.
suggestedPrompts: In Notepad, behind my window, type a shopping list and save it on the Desktop.
Open Calculator and compute 1234 × 5678 without taking my mouse.
List my open windows, then read the text of the Notepad window behind this one.
